note: Local-only mockups of brooks-security.com. Nothing here is deployed; the site itself is untouched. Variants are served from this directory on the seedbox over the tailnet.

variants.name: Typographic Index
variants.brief: Text and type only, near-monochrome. Home is a centred face, name, a keyword cloud of what he works in, and a large-text index of six sections. Each section slides over the index in place: no page loads, hash-routed, mobile-first motion.
